scenes.line1: Why does JVM run out of memory?
scenes.line2: How do you spot the cause?
scenes.say: Ever seen your Java app crash with an out-of-memory error? How would you figure out what's behind it?

scenes.label: Kinds
scenes.sub: Heap space, Metaspace, and GC overhead limit exceeded are the main types.
scenes.say: Out-of-memory can hit your heap, metaspace, or just overwhelm garbage collection. Each needs a different fix.

scenes.title: Capture the Problem
scenes.say: Grab a heap dump using jcmd or jmap. This snapshot lets you see exactly which objects are hogging memory.

rows.b: Use Eclipse MAT to spot leaks

scenes.say: First, turn on heap dumps. Then, grab the dump when the error happens. Finally, open it in Eclipse MAT to hunt for leaks.

scenes.question: What causes Metaspace OutOfMemoryError?
scenes.right: Class loader leaks or dynamic class creation fill up metaspace.
scenes.say: Here's a classic interview trap: Metaspace errors aren't about threads—they're usually from class loader leaks or too many dynamic classes.
